mapper.select: select a.USER_ID AS personnelId,a.NAME as name,a.ID_NUMBER as idCardNumber, a.MAJOR as major,a.ISSUE_DATE as regDate, IF(d1.ID is not null,d1.DICT_LABEL,a.CERT_TYPE) as type, IF(d2.ID is not null,d2.DICT_LABEL,a.LEVEL) as level from (select cert.*, IF(b.ID is not null or c.ID is not null,1,cert.CERT_STATUS ) as userStatus from HR_CERT_MANAGE cert left join PERSONNEL b on cert.USER_TYPE='总部' and cert.USER_ID = b.ID and b.STATUS = '1' and b.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' left join HR_SUB_PERSONNEL c on cert.USER_TYPE='分公司' and cert.USER_ID = c.ID and c.HR_STATUS = '1' and c.`STATUS` in ('0','1') and c.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' where cert.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' and cert.TYPE = '注册证书' and cert.USER_ID = #{personnelId} ) a left join DEV_DICT d1 on a.CERT_TYPE_ID = d1.ID and d1.CATEGORY='BIZ' left join DEV_DICT d2 on a.LEVEL_ID = d2.ID and d2.CATEGORY='BIZ' where a.userStatus = '0'
